title: Saga #43 Image 2017 Brian K. Vaughan Fiona Staples 25 Cent Cover 1st Print
conditionDescription: Bright cover; a small dark mark near the left edge of the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Saga #43 (2017), Image Comics - Chapter Forty Three, the 25-cent Image 25th anniversary issue. Written by Brian K. Vaughan, art and cover by Fiona Staples.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; a small dark mark near the left edge of the back cover (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
